subject: 0099 READY for P8b link (host-only): patch 6d9dbb13, objects + symbol check; two link levels
body: Patch gpu/build/ansuz-port-20261026/0099/0099-nord2-core-aware-sched-cpuclk.patch sha256 6d9dbb133efed943... (applies after 0084; verified patch -p1 on pristine stage copies reproduces src/ byte-for-byte). Objects (compile_0099.py: CI build.log flags of osfmk/kern/sched_clutch.c and bsd/dev/sweet_touch.c, -target arm64-apple-macos14.0, same Apple-builtin defines as xnu_staged_compile.py CXX_FLAGS, nice19 j1): objs/nord2_sched.o f73d8d43, objs/nord2_sched_sysctl.o d0a0c7e3, objs/sched_clutch.o fbf1f1a4, objs/sched_prim.o 9dd27394. Symbol check vs CI kernel.development.sweet.a: all 53 undefined symbols of the two new objects resolve; replaced members define exactly the same global set as the CI sched_clutch.o/sched_prim.o, undefined diff = only +nord2_sched_{choose_processor,balance,avoid_processor,switch} -choose_processor -sched_SMT_balance (now called via nord2). LINK LEVEL (a) measurement only, zero scheduler risk: ADD nord2_sched.o + nord2_sched_sysctl.o to the object list (functions unused except the EARLY_BOOT init/report thread). LEVEL (b) placement: ALSO replace archive members sched_clutch.o + sched_prim.o (clang23-compiled core scheduler: higher risk; please keep (a) as the default image). Behaviour: default unchanged (n2sch=0); always-on: per-switch accounting, 'NORD2 SCHED init' line, 2 'NORD2 SCHED' lines/60 s, 'NORD2 CPUCLK 0:MHz..7:MHz' at 45 s then every 300 s (dependent-add chain per CPU via thread_bind, skips offline CPUs). Big mask auto 0xf0 from ADT compatible 'arm,cortex-a78' (verified in ui350/gpu.adt). Boot-args (short): n2sch=0xf (placement on), n2schab=120 (in-boot A/B: alternate 0/0xf every 120 s with 'NORD2 SCHED AB phase=' markers; analyze_nord2_sched.py splits TEGU_PERF windows by phase), n2clk=<s>, n2csram=1 (read-only MT6893 cpuhvfs CSRAM 0x0011bc00: cur OPP idx LL/L/B, vproc, sched req, tbl0; ml_io_map; opt-in because an inaccessible PA would SError). Request: probe image with (a)+n2csram=1 to answer 'are our CPUs at max clock?'; UI image with (b)+n2schab=120 for the placement A/B. Host tests: tests/nord2_sched_policy_test.c ASan+UBSan 43/43 PASS; tests/test_analyze_nord2_sched.py PASS (also asserts every printf format the analyzer parses is in the kernel source).
